definition.def: You use sustainable to describe the use of natural resources when this use is kept at a steady level that is not likely to damage the environment.
examples: ...the management, conservation and sustainable development of forests.
Try to buy wood that you know has come from a sustainable source.

definition.def: A sustainable plan, method, or system is designed to continue at the same rate or level of activity without any problems.
examples: The creation of an efficient and sustainable transport system is critical to the long-term future of London.
